notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Kiki-Jiki.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Morgue Toad with haste.
Activate the Morgue Toad token by sacrificing it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
